description: A programming framework for agentic AI

sources.entry: AutoGen *(Microsoft)* — Multi-agent conversation framework. Agents collaborate, code, and debate to solve problems. CC-BY-4.0.

summary.one_liner: AutoGen is Microsoft's Python (and .NET) framework for building multi-agent AI applications, now archived and no longer maintained by Microsoft.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes AutoGen as a framework for creating multi-agent AI applications that can act autonomously or work alongside humans. It has a layered design: a Core API for message passing, event-driven agents and local or distributed runtimes (Python and .NET), an AgentChat API for simpler prototyping of patterns like two-agent chat and group chats, and an Extensions API for LLM clients (such as OpenAI and AzureOpenAI) and capabilities like code execution. Quickstart examples show an OpenAI-backed assistant agent, connecting an agent to the Playwright MCP server, and using AgentTool to let one agent call other expert agents. The ecosystem also includes AutoGen Studio, a no-code GUI for prototyping workflows, and AutoGen Bench, a benchmarking suite. Magentic-One is named as an example multi-agent team built on AgentChat and Extensions.
use_cases: build agents that call other specialized agents as tools
connect an LLM agent to MCP servers such as a browser
research and experimentation with agent orchestration
notable: Layered design: Core API, AgentChat API, and Extensions API that can be used at different abstraction levels
AgentTool lets one agent invoke other agents as tools for multi-agent orchestration
AutoGen Studio no-code GUI for prototyping
caveats: Archived and no longer maintained by Microsoft; no bug or security fixes, and the README advises against production use
AutoGen Studio is a prototype, not production-ready
Microsoft recommends Microsoft Agent Framework for new projects; community support only via Discord and GitHub Discussions
keywords: build ai assistants with multiple agents
agents that collaborate to solve problems
